projects.title: Project Starhaven
projects.description: A narrative-driven isometric space colony city builder. Manage resources, keep your colonists alive and happy, and weather both the elements and the demands of your overbearing boss! Led development of the game design, writing and programming for this project developed in Godot as part of UBC Game Dev Club.
